text:
Maya: Morning yall, who botched semver overnight? My afternoon espresso is on the line.
Alex: Not me. Blame the YAML gremlins. Found `version: 1.0` in prod-config.yml and almost cried.
Sam: Someone earlier committed `version: one-dot-oh`. CI shrugged and so did I. :man_shrugging: 
Jin: New ritual proposal: every semver break requires bringing breakfast pastries. :croissant: Enforcement via toast ledger.
Maya: Also thinking of a lightweight YAML ritual cleansing: `yq eval '.version |= sub("v?","")' -i prod-config.yml` and a prayer.
BuildBot: [automated message] build #518 failed: YAML parse error at line 12
Alex: Offending line: ```version: 'v1' # please stop```
Sam: Can we add a pre-commit hook to canonicalize version fields? Or convert them to :octocat: so humans can't ruin it.
Jin: I volunteer as Toast Keeper if we get a literal toaster wall. I'll engrave a plaque: "Semver Sins Begone"
Maya: Quick poll: react :thumbsup: for toaster wall, :rocket: for pre-commit hook. Loser bakes.
Alex: :thumbsup:
Sam: :rocket:
Maya: It's a tie. Tie-breaker: whoever fixes the YAML gets the last croissant. Deal?
BuildBot: [automated message] deploy succeeded after manual patch. Toast Keeper: TBD.
